title: retrace check --format json, format_version 1
description: The document that `retrace check --format json` writes (spec §9.9.7). Values read from a cassette, such as tool names, are not constrained further than their type and are not escaped: a cassette is untrusted input, and this is the faithful form (spec §10). Objects are open: consumers must ignore members they do not know (spec §8.4).

format_version.description: Incremented, with a new schema file, by any change that is not backward compatible.

model.description: The --model of a swap-model check, or null.

interrupted.description: True when a signal stopped the check: the replays that never started are skipped (spec §9.9.4).

out.description: The directory of the replays, or null when nothing was written because the budget refused the check.

cost.description: The estimated cost billed by all the replays: live responses only (spec §9.9.6).

sessions.description: Sessions by outcome: the first of diverged, error, skipped and identical that any of its replays has.

diverged_at.description: The divergence points of the whole corpus grouped by event kind and tool, in descending order of sessions.

tool.description: Null for an event without a tool, such as a stop marker or a cassette miss.

sessions.description: Sessions with a divergence point of this kind and tool.
One entry per session of the corpus, in id order.

estimate_usd.description: The estimate of the whole check: an estimate from the price table, not a cap on billing.

refused.description: True when the estimate exceeded the budget and no replay started.

cost.description: A cost in the format of spec §8.2. For a replay, its billed cost (spec §9.9.6).

cost_usd.description: The sum of the known costs of the live responses, in US dollars. It leaves out the unpriced responses: a null cost is never guessed (spec §7.5).

unpriced_responses.description: Live model responses with tokens but no known cost.

counts.description: A count for every outcome, zeros included.

divergence_points.description: The divergence points of its replays grouped by step, event kind and tool, in descending order of replays.

text_differences.description: The steps whose text differs in any replay and was not compared, which is only possible without --text (spec §8.3).

id.description: The id of the replay's cassette in --out.

reason.description: Why, when retrace knows: budget for a replay the budget skipped, or a timeout. Null otherwise.

divergence.description: For a diverged replay, where it left its source, as `retrace diff --format json` gives first_divergence (spec §8.4), with the source as A and the replay as B. Null otherwise, and for a replay that diverged on a cassette miss with no earlier difference.

step.description: The step number. For kind stop it is the last step, and the stop marker is after it.

kind.description: The kind of event compared. model_response when the texts differ under --text, or when only one side has the step; stop when only the stop markers differ.

field.description: What diff is about. Null, with an empty diff, when the events differ elsewhere (kind, source, target, tool or status), when a side has no event, and for kind stop.

a.description: Side A's event, or null when side A has no event left in the step, and for kind stop.

b.description: Side B's event, as a is for side A.

stop_a.description: Side A's stop marker for kind stop, or null: also for a side with no model response.

stop_b.description: Side B's stop marker, as stop_a is for side A.

diff.description: The paths where field differs, with A as expected and B as received (spec §6.4).

diff_truncated.description: True when paths were left out of diff or a value was elided as "[retrace: <n> bytes elided]" (spec §6.4).

more_paths.description: True when more paths differ than diff lists.

event.description: The members of an event that action identity compares (spec §8.3 step 1), and its seq. arguments and result are the stored JSON, or a string when the stored value is not JSON.

marker.description: A stop marker (spec §8.2): the stop_reason of the last model response, or its error when its status is error.

failed.description: True when the response's status is error.

entry.description: One path that differs. A side without the path has no member: expected for A, received for B. A value whose compact JSON is longer than 1024 bytes is replaced by the string "[retrace: <n> bytes elided]", and diff_truncated is set (spec §6.4).
